summary.name: Nucleo
summary.one_liner: Nucleo is an icon library of 40,000+ SVG icons for UI and marketing that can be browsed, copied, and customized in a web app or used with AI agents via an MCP server.
use_cases: finding icons for a UI or dashboard design
copying SVG icons into a web project
customizing icon styles for a product
giving AI agents access to icons via MCP
summary.what_it_does: The page advertises over 40,000 SVG icons organized into icon families, aimed at UI and marketing work. Users can browse the icons, copy them, and customize them in the Nucleo web app. The site also offers a Nucleo MCP server and agent skills so AI agents can use the icons. A listing in the awesome-mac directory describes it as an icon manager that can import, export, customize and convert icon libraries. The page text itself is mostly testimonials from designers and does not detail pricing or specific export formats.
notable: 40,000+ SVG icons organized into icon families
Nucleo MCP server and agent skills for AI agents
Browse, copy and customize icons in a web app
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page text is mostly testimonials and gives few technical details
